reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Please don't stack two pre-workouts. Each one carries its own caffeine and stimulant load, and doubling up can push your heart rate and blood pressure too high, cause jitters, insomnia, or worse. If you want more energy, use one product at its labeled serving, and check with a doctor or pharmacist first if you have any heart condition, take blood pressure medication, or are sensitive to caffeine. Then tell me what you're training for and we'll get the session right."}
